data.display_address: Rukan Tower C, Rukan Tower, Rukan, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover this well-designed 1-bedroom apartment in Rukan Residence Building C, offering a peaceful setting with a relaxing pool view. Spanning 774 sq ft, this unfurnished unit is perfect for tenants or investors looking to customize their space.

The apartment features a smart and spacious layout with a bright living area, large windows allowing natural light, and a modern open kitchen. The bedroom includes built-in wardrobes and an en-suite bathroom, complemented by an additional guest bathroom for extra convenience.

Property Features:

-1 Bedroom apartment
-2 Bathrooms
-Size: 774 sqft
-Unfurnished
-Pool-facing unit
-Open-plan kitchen
-Built-in wardrobes
-Bright and airy layout

Building Amenities:

-Swimming pool
-Fully equipped gym
-Landscaped gardens
-Children’s play area
-Walking and jogging tracks
-24/7 security & CCTV
-Covered parking

Community & Area Features:

Located in Rukan Community, the development offers a tranquil lifestyle away from the city’s hustle while remaining well-connected.
 
-Easy access to Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
-Close to Arabian Ranches and Dubai Sports City
-Nearby supermarkets, cafes, and retail outlets
-Family-friendly gated community
-Green spaces and parks within the community

Ideal for those seeking comfort, privacy, and a serene environment in a growing residential area.
